title: Universal Life Insurance Owner Election Terms: Exercise of Overloan Protection
content:
## Terms of the election

When an approved overloan protection election on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy is carried out, the policy becomes guaranteed paid-up coverage under death benefit Option A and its face amount becomes the protected face.

The protected face is not fixed until the overloan protection charge stands deducted in the policy's activity history.

In the same terms: as long as the activity history shows no overloan protection charge deducted, there is no protected face to fix.

| Activity history | Protected face |
|---|---|
| Shows the overloan protection charge deducted | This condition is met |
| Shows no overloan protection charge | Not yet fixed |

## Owner's election tool: `exercise_overloan_protection_1091dc6b`

**Capability.** Lets the policy owner carry out their own approved overloan protection election on their Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy by confirming the protected face shown to them. One call turns the policy into overloan-protected paid-up coverage: the policy status becomes overloan protected, the death benefit option becomes A, the face amount becomes the confirmed protected face, and the election request is marked completed. The election cannot be undone; afterwards the policy no longer accepts premiums, withdrawals or new loans.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves, the owner, runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ul_policy_id` | The reference number of the owner's universal life policy, read from the universal life policy lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `ul_request_id` | The reference number of the owner's approved overloan protection election request, read from the universal life service request lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `protected_face_amount` | The protected face the owner confirms | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half-up to the cent |

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `ul_policy_id` (the policy), `ul_request_id` (the election carried out), `status` (`overloan_protected` once carried out), `death_benefit_option` (`A`) and `face_amount` (the protected face now in force, USD with 2 decimal places). No other return is defined.

## Questions answered

**Can the election be reversed afterwards?** No; the tool's effect cannot be undone.

**What does the policy show once the election is carried out? (hypothetical)** A policy carried out with a protected face of $202650.00 shows the status overloan protected, death benefit Option A and a face amount of $202650.00, and its election request reads completed.
